responsibility: This file implements the SPARC-specific gcc driver helper for -mcpu=native and -mtune=native expansion. It runs on the host side rather than in RTL generation, probes the local machine’s processor identity through Solaris kstat or /proc/cpuinfo, maps host CPU brand strings to GCC’s internal SPARC cpu names such as supersparc, ultrasparc3, niagara*, leon3, and m8, and returns the replacement command-line option string that the driver injects into the cc1 invocation.
